scope: Pinned native Crayon2/Renderer Init, direct saved-ObjectStroke RedrawPen playback, queued worker, Update, and Draw under Unicorn with actual host Mesa GLES; this route does not enter Drawing. Model setters create the source stroke, while the runner separately writes the factory-created Crayon2 setting record to supply renderer pen size. Saved ObjectStroke ARGB is recorded as Model input but forwarding it into the Crayon2 shader color is not established; the captured GL uniforms and RGBA are renderer observations. Queue acceptance, modeled bionic RNG, EGL/GL resource setup, and host bitmap/canvas are adapters. This is not Samsung-device or actual-note pixel parity.

host_injected_renderer_setting.purpose: runner host write supplying the renderer setting; not a Drawing-side setting update
